header.capture_method: set -a; . ~/.factory-dispatcher/env; set +a; venv/bin/python with sys.path += apps/factory-dispatcher; substrate.default_store(); GET only (httpx.request wrapped to refuse any non-GET); every population paged by offset at limit 200 until a short page (dev.task, dev.note per parent_id, arch.release, arch.change, arch.requirement_conformance, dev.release, arch.observation); links via GET /beads/{id}/links (unpaged route).
header.date_in_filename: The filename keeps the 2026-09-23 date the design (docs/plans/2026-09-23-design-r2612-steerable-and-legible.md, 'Fixtures the outer loop commits with the first specs (D7)') and the PC-* acceptance criteria name; the capture itself is dated by captured_at.

The only latched bead left is 44d28ff9 on the same heartbeat-timeout signature 2d5ae89f the design recorded. The beads selectable at this capture are excluded by construction (below), as the design requires; none of the pending set's hold reasons was edited.
header.pending_ids_note: pending_ids lists the pending beads CAPTURED in tasks, i.e. every pending bead minus excluded_selectable_ids, so 'every id in header.pending_ids appears exactly once across ranked + held' holds over the fixture; pending_count_in_store is the store's full pending population at capture.
header.latched_rule: dispatch.trailing_environmental_fault_streak(list_notes(id)) returns (signature, streak) with signature non-empty and streak >= retry_policy.CONSECUTIVE_ENVIRONMENTAL_FAULT_LIMIT (3) -- pick_task's own test
header.latched_with_later_exit_notes_rule: per latched id: the newest environmental-fault note's created_at, and the resets_attempts (requeue barrier) and 'Worker finished in' notes created after it -- the notes B3 makes end the streak; the breaker still holds the bead at capture

header.hold_class_rule: hold class is derived from the guards.is_runnable reason text by this fixture builder (no class vocabulary exists in code at main_revision; B4 creates one): 'latched' (is_runnable ok, streak >= limit); 'superseded' (reason starts 'superseded by bead'); 'predecessor' (any ordering_block_reason text); 'release_not_in_flight' ('delivers <ref> (<state>), not in_flight'); 'attempts_exhausted'; 'blocking_question' ('waiting on blocking question' or 'blocking question ... does not declare release'); 'no_scope'. A B4 vocabulary that names these differently maps onto them one-to-one.
header.predecessor_pairs_rule: [dependent_id, predecessor_id] for every captured pending bead whose guards.ordering_block_reason is non-empty, one pair per declared predecessor that is not in state 'done' (guards.SUCCESSFUL_TERMINAL_STATES) or not found
header.excluded_selectable_rule: SELECTABLE BEADS ARE EXCLUDED BY CONSTRUCTION: a pending bead with is_runnable ok and streak < limit at capture is dropped from tasks/notes_by_task/links and listed here, so selectable_ids is [] on every capture. Excluded, not asserted absent.
header.is_runnable_inputs: guards.is_runnable(task, list_notes(id), list_tasks() [all 479 dev.task beads], release_by_task_id=dispatch.resolve_task_release_states(store, pending)) -- the same call pick_task makes

reconstruction_check.rule: every hold_reason_by_id entry and every (signature, streak) re-derived from THIS FILE alone (tasks + all_task_ids_by_state as stub tasks + links/releases for release_by_task_id + notes_by_task with body_first_line mapped to body)

header.note_reduction: Each note is {id, created_at, created_by, content: {kind, body_first_line = dispatch.redact_sensitive_output(body).splitlines()[0][:200], ...kind extras}}. status: + environmental_fault_signature, resets_attempts, preserved_choice, releases_work, expedite, class_of_service, expedite_reason, expedite_until (each only if present on the stored note) and requeue_reason (derived: for a resets_attempts note the text after guards._REQUEUE_REASON_MARKER 'Reason:' with the _REQUEUE_PRESERVED_SUFFIX_MARKER tail stripped, parsed from the FULL redacted body; else null). review: + verdict, url (+ pr_url when the stored note carries one). question: + blocking, answers_ref. answer: + answers_ref (+ releases_work when present -- guards.open_questions reads it on the answer, so it is kept there too). attachment: + url. Dropped: provenance, context, trust_tier, full bodies. To feed a reduced note to a guards/dispatch function that reads content.body, map body_first_line -> body; every prefix those functions test for is on the first line (verified at build: see header.reconstruction_check).
header.redaction: no provenance, no worker/model fields, no full bodies; PR URLs kept
header.no_expected_values: The header records what was captured; no expected value is written here or in any AC -- ACs read header fields.
